anchors.meaning: Receiver decodes the actual effect opcode through its two-stage table.
Receiver opcode17 maps to the direct hit path; opcode18 is separate.
Direct hit callback calls special applicator and accumulates EXP and actual HP/MP deltas.
Special wrapper selects channel1; full application returns without a number renderer.
After the current effect program finishes, advance to the next cached unique target and restart the defense program.
Special cost is paid once before creating the attacking animation.
Only after receiver completion does the actor enter the defeated-target scan.
Deferred death scan counts each death but increments the kill chain only on the first.
Death scan advances targets without repeating the already-finished damage program.

limits: Direct special applicator returns normally; real opcode17 dispatch stops before its first presentation call.
Five source hit callbacks per unique target, then next receiver target. HP0 callbacks still sample but add no damage or experience.
Death scan follows all receiver programs: all pulses use the pre-cast kill chain; final chain increments once per action.
Synthetic register/map inputs; no original full renderer, global object scheduling or real-time playback equivalence.
